- ⟦{事務局|じむきょく}→事務局：17056_jimukyoku⟧ (secretariat)

WATCH OUT:
Japan's weather service is the ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧, not {気象局|きしょうきょく}. As a counter, {局|きょく} counts games of go or shogi: {一局|いっきょく} (one game).
